title: Rocket Money Subscription Weekly Days To Renewal Trend
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rocketmoney:subscription days_to_renewal=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_to_renewal) as avg_duration, max(days_to_renewal) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days to renewal for Rocket Money subscription events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_to_renewal on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days to renewal with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Rocket Money subscription tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
